title: Shaft of a Broken Spear
summary: Combine with the Head of a Broken Spear to assemble Vision of the Absolute.

fields.Combine: Use the Head and Shaft together in the combining interface.
fields.Acquisition: On Edowin in the Forest west of the Druid Grove at X 136, Y 446.
